## Our probes, pairs in the same block

`fee_first`: share of pairs (different price) where the higher price sits earlier. `sent_first`: share of pairs where the probe sent earlier sits earlier. `fee_wins_duel`: only pairs where the higher price was sent later (the two rules disagree); share where the higher price still sits earlier. 95% CI by resampling bursts.
